title: selfdoc numbers a source's lines by LF alone in map_tools and check_map
goal: selfdoc.map_tools and selfdoc.check_map split a source on LF alone (not str.splitlines), so a literal U+2028, U+2029 or U+0085 in a _tools file neither shifts the map's line numbers nor makes check_map fail; a test plants each character in a source and sees map_tools and check_map agree with the LF numbering
